arxiv.summary: We introduce TRACE, a cross-domain engineering framework for trustworthy agentic AI in operationally critical domains. arxiv.title: Improving Model Safety by Targeted Error Correction
arxiv.summary: The widespread adoption of machine learning in critical applications demands techniques to mitigate high-consequence errors. Our method utilizes a dual-classifier GBDT pipeline to distinguish routine human-like errors from high-risk non-human misclassifications. arxiv.title: To Build or Not to Build? Factors that Lead to Non-Development or Abandonment of AI Systems
